dialogs.about: 할아버지와 저녁을 함께 준비하며 나누는 이야기

lines.en: Can you peel the potatoes for me?
Of course. Where is the small knife?
It is next to the bowl on the table.
Thank you. Should I grate the carrot too?
Yes, please. I will simmer the soup now.
lines.ko: 네, 부탁해요. 저는 이제 국을 뭉근히 끓일게요.

lines.en: It smells good. What did you cook yesterday?
I roasted a chicken yesterday.
It was warm and soft that day.
Today I will marinate the fish for dinner.
lines.ko: 오늘은 저녁을 위해 생선을 재워 둘게요.

lines.en: Fine. I will squeeze some orange juice.
lines.ko: 좋아요. 저는 오렌지 주스를 짜 놓을게요.

dialogs.about: 동네 요리 교실에서 선생님께 감자 요리를 배우는 이야기

lines.en: Good afternoon. Today we will cook potatoes.
lines.ko: 안녕하세요. 오늘은 감자 요리를 할 거예요.

lines.en: Hello, Teacher. Should I peel them first?
Yes, peel them and grate one carrot.
lines.ko: 네, 껍질을 벗기고 당근 하나를 갈아 주세요.

lines.en: I grated carrots at home yesterday.
Very good. Now simmer them in this pot.
lines.ko: 아주 좋아요. 이제 이 냄비에 뭉근히 끓이세요.

lines.en: How long should I simmer it?
For twenty minutes. Then sprinkle some pepper.
lines.ko: 이십 분 동안요. 그다음 후추를 뿌리세요.

lines.en: May I dip the bread in the soup?
Of course. Please taste it and tell me.
It is warm and soft. Thank you.
